    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), x), y), velocity), score), alive), collected), frame), trail)

    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), x), y), velocity), score), alive), collected), frame), trail)
